image_query: Dilwara Temples Mount Abu marble ceiling carving Vimal Vasahi
tweets: Dilwara Temples, Mount Abu — the exterior is plain, almost severe. Step inside, and the same white marble turns to lace: ceilings carved into rosettes so fine they seem to float. Vimal Vasahi temple, 1031 CE, raised for the Jain Tīrthaṅkara Ṛṣabhanātha.
